units.source_text: 我等会员接着跟他打听拿破仑、孔子、陀思妥耶夫斯基、达尔文、

en.t: We members then asked him about Napoleon, Confucius, Dostoevsky, Darwin,

units.source_text: 克莉奥佩特拉、释迦牟尼、德漠斯特涅斯 、但丁、千利休等幽灵的消息。

en.t: Cleopatra, Shakyamuni, Demosthenes, Dante, Sen no Rikyu, and the news of other ghosts like them.

units.source_text: 遗憾的是托喀君没能详细地回答。

en.t: Unfortunately, Mr. Tock was unable to answer in detail.

units.source_text: 托喀君却反问起那些和他有关的种种流言蜚语。

en.t: Instead, Mr. Tock asked us in return about the various rumors and gossip concerning him.
